tickets.title: Archive all-campaign character and narrator intent
gate_cmd:
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/design-intent/characters-and-narrator')
assert hashlib.sha256((p/'owner-excerpt.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='13ac181d66188c6f49a8d19360bfd852a7261832168724127111416a057ef752'
r=json.loads((p/'record.json').read_text())
assert r['status']=='intent_not_implemented' and r['campaign_scope']=='all_argo_campaigns'
assert r['scope_decision']['answer']=='All ARGO campaigns'
assert r['complete_v3_received'] is False and r['paid_model_calls']==0
for f,h in r['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((p/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
v=json.loads(Path('SYSTEMS/CONTRACT_FREEZE.json').read_text())
for f,h in v['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h,f
print('PASS supplied intent archive and unchanged v1; no implementation approval')
